NewsArticle.Title: Free day added to all subscriptions
NewsArticle.Content: Due to a server error, some people were unable to connect to the game from 10pm to 6am on Thursday, 11/16/00. The problem has been corrected and all registered accounts will be credited one day. We apologize for any inconvience. Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, test your connection ( [http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm) ).
